metadata.description: A single-plugin marketplace for the GRO Compiler — a live, per-turn GRO material compiler for Claude Code, bundled with a pinned ARA research-manager.

plugins.name: gro-compiler
plugins.description: Per-turn (live) GRO material compiler bundled with a pinned ARA research-manager: one install, one thing. Each turn research-manager records the research into the project's ARA, then gro-compiler compiles the GRO material layer (temporal, refs, quantities, entities, claims_typed, genre, author-stated contributions) on top. Pure material compilation — no third-party quality assessment.
